response.sql: WITH shares AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.a) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.a
